Subject: Post-call recap + VP/CTO intro & proposed demo windows

Hi Emily — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call:

- Primary objective: Evaluate Redwood Inference for high-throughput inference of clinical NLP models; key constraints are latency <150ms p95 for 512-token requests and HIPAA-compliant auditability.
- Data residency: US-only (east coast) required for pilot.
- Success criteria: pilot demonstrating ~20% cost-per-token reduction and end-to-end latency improvements without degradation in AUC on current eval set.

Suggested next steps (to unblock procurement):
1) Intro call between your VP Eng / CTO and our VP Eng (Shirley Wong) + lead infra engineer to validate architecture and SLA expectations.
2) Technical deep dive + demo (45–60 min) focused on model serving, quantization choices, KV cache behavior, and telemetry.

Proposed windows (all US ET):
- Tue Jul 11 | 10:00–11:00 ET
- Wed Jul 12 | 14:00–15:00 ET
- Thu Jul 13 | 09:00–10:00 ET

If none of these work, please suggest 2–3 windows and I will coordinate. Recommended attendees: your CTO/VP Eng, infra lead; from our side: Shirley Wong (VP Eng), Monica Patel (Solutions Eng), and me.

Attaching our short discovery notes (discovery-notes.pdf) and a proposed demo outline (MVP-demo-outline.md). I called out the compliance checklist items below so we can prep any evidence your security team will want:
- SOC 2 readiness and audit log retention policy
- KMS/HSM integration for key material
- Network isolation options for a pilot (VPC peering or private deployment)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

— Priyom
